Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the run chase! The Bangladesh players are in a huddle and then they make their way out to the middle, followed by Matthew Wade and Ben McDermott. Mahedi Hasan will start with the ball.

Australia were top notch with the ball! Everyone did a terrific job and they have a good chance of winning their first game. Ashton Turner did a pretty good job in his 4 overs while Ashton Agar was good as well. Mitchell Swepson, playing his first game on this tour, was the standout bowler as he picked up three and completely foxed the batsmen out there. Andrew Tye and Josh Hazlewood were tidy as well. Now it is up to their batsmen to get the job done. They have struggled in this series but this is a good chance for them to win and stop Bangladesh's charge. Will they be able to do it? We will find out as the run chase begins in a short while.

Bangladesh never got going in their innings and they kept on losing wickets at regular intervals. They lost their first one early and then Shakib Al Hasan struggled big time. There was nothing much from Mahmudullah, Nurul Hasan and Afif Hossain. At one stage, they looked like they will not even reach 100 but Mahedi Hasan's cameo has got them to 104. It may not be enough but with the way they have bowled in this series, they might have an outside chance.

An excellent bowling performance from Australia! They have restricted Bangladesh to just 104 in their 20 overs and they will be pleased but their batting has not done them favours in this series. They would hope that they can come good to chase this down and get their first win of the series. Bangladesh, on the other hand, will be disappointed with their batting performance. The hosts would need to put up another good show with the ball if they want to make it 4-0.

OUT! Another wicket to finish off the innings! Back of a length delivery around leg, Shoriful Islam hangs back to heave it across the line but doesn't get the distance. Ben McDermott keeps his eyes on the ball and grabs it safely at deep mid-wicket. 14 runs and a couple of wickets from the final over, Bangladesh finish on 104/9!
Commentary.Howout: c Ben McDermott b Andrew Tye

Commentary.Commentary: Shoriful Islam comes out.

OUT! Mahedi's cameo is over. Fuller in length and around off, Hasan clears his front leg for a big shot over the infield on the off side but only manages to get it away from the bottom half of his blade. Alex Carey takes a simple catch at extra cover.
Commentary.Howout: c Alex Carey b Andrew Tye

Commentary.Commentary: Full toss on middle and leg, Mahedi tries to swipe it across the line but it goes behind square leg off the inside edge. They take a couple.
SIX! 100 up for Bangladesh! Short in length and around off, Mahedi stands tall to receive this delivery and pulls it all the way over square leg for a maximum.

FOUR! A much-needed boundary for Bangladesh. Can they touch 100 now? Fuller in length and around off, Mahedi goes hard with the swing of his bat and inside edges it through backward square leg for a boundary.

DROPPED! A good attempt from Josh Hazlewood though. A length ball around off, slower in pace, Mahedi shuffles across to glance it on the leg side but gets a top edge. It flies to the left of short third man, Josh rushes across to his left, stretches his body but fails to hang on. They take a couple.

Swing and a miss! Yet another slower delivery, a touch short and outside off, Nasum winds up for a big heave over the leg side but swings his bat 7 days in advance. End of a top 4-over spell by Josh Hazlewood, 24/2.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Mahedi hangs back and cuts it from the outer half to short third man. A good diving stop inside the ring and the batsmen will get only a run.
Slower one again, on a length around off, angling in at 114.3 kph, Mahedi is way too early into the shot and is hit on the right shoulder. Dot ball.
Hazlewood switches to 'round the wicket for the left-hander and delivers a length ball on off, Nasum steps back and forces it through covers for a single.
Hazlewood senses the charge from the batsman and digs in a slower short ball on off, at 116 clicks, Mahedi drags his pull shot down to long on for a run.
Short in length and outside off, Mahedi cuts it through point and Agar stops the ball after running across to his left from sweeper cover. Two runs are taken.
Slower ball outside off, Nasum Ahmed looks to swing it away but misses.
Shortish ball outside off, Mahedi plays it to short third man for a single.
Slower ball on off, Nasum defends it to cover and takes a run.
Full ball outside off, Nasum looks to defend but misses.
Nasum Ahmed is the next man in.
OUT! CAUGHT! Simple catch and Shamim Hossain also goes. Slower ball on the pads, Shamim looks to flick but is early into the shot and it goes to mid-wicket where Carey takes the catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Alex Carey b Andrew Tye

Commentary.Commentary: Good length ball on off, Hasan guides it to short third man for one.
Andrew Tye is back on.
Loopy ball outside off, Shamim looks to sweep but misses.
Tossed up on middle, Hasan nudges it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Floated on off, Shamim drives it to long off for a single.
On off, pushed to cover.

NOT OUT! Shamim Hossain is in! Loopy ball on middle, Mahedi Hasan flicks it to mid-wicket and takes off for a single. The fielder throws it to Wade who whips the bails off. The third umpire is called for and the replays show that Shamim is in.
An appeal for run out taken upstairs. It looks like Shamim Hossain is in and he is.
Flatter on middle, Hasan works it to the leg side.
Shorter and outside off, Hasan cuts it to deep point for one.
Flatter ball on off, Mahedi Hasan defends it out.
Who comes out now? Mahedi Hasan it is.

OUT! CAUGHT! Ashton Agar has the last laugh! Afif Hossain goes and Australia continue to dominate! Loopy ball on off, Afif Hossain looks to go over deep mid-wicket but it does not have the elevation and the distance. Moises Henriques takes a good catch in the deep.
Commentary.Howout: c Moises Henriques b Ashton Agar

Commentary.Commentary: Full on middle, Shamim pushes it to long on for a single.
Flatter ball on middle, Afif works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! Bangladesh needed this! Full toss on middle, Afif powers it over deep square leg for a maximum.
Full outside off, Afif drives it to deep cover for one.
Full on off, Afif reverse sweeps it to short third man.
Full on off, Shamim drives it to long off for one.
Shamim Hossain is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Swepson gets his third! Brilliant performance from him. Tossed up on off, Naim looks to sweep but it takes the top edge and goes to the side of the pitch on the off side. Wade settles under it and takes the catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Matthew Wade b Mitchell Swepson

Commentary.Commentary: Review time! Australia have taken a review again. This looks close too. Let's see how it pans out.

NOT OUT! Pitching outside leg! Flatter ball on middle and leg, Naim looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. An appeal is made for LBW but the umpire is unmoved. Australia take the review. The Ultra Edge shows no bat while the Ball Tracker shows that it is pitching outside leg.
Full outside off, Naim pushes it to cover for one.
Flatter on middle, Hossain defends it back to the bowler.
Flatter ball on middle, Naim works it to the leg side for a single.
On off, pushed to the off side for one.

Fantastic effort from Dan Christian! Outstanding stuff. Loopy ball on off, Hossain goes down on his knees and slogs it wide of long on. Christian runs across, jumps and then pulls the back in. Saves a six. Two runs in the end.
Flatter on middle, Hossain tucks it to the leg side for another couple of runs.2 runs.
Loopy ball on middle, Hossain clips it to deep mid-wicket for two.
Flatter ball on the pads, Hossain works it to the leg side for one.
Tossed up on off, Hossain defends it to the off side.
Short ball on middle, Hossain pulls it to deep square leg for a couple of runs.
Loopy ball outside off, Hossain looks to play the reverse sweep but misses.
Full on middle, Naim works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Nicely bowled by Swepson! Flatter ball on off, Naim plays it back to the bowler.
Full on off, driven to long off for one.
Good length ball on middle, Hossain works it to deep square leg for one.
Full on off, Hossain defends it to cover. Naim wants a single but is sent back. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Would have been close.
Good length ball outside off, Hossain cuts it through point for two.
Good length ball on off, Naim pushes it to cover for one.
A slower ball on middle, Naim looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Afif Hossain makes his way out to the middle. Moises Henriques is into the attack.
Australia have taken a review for LBW! Let's see what happens.

OUT! LBW! What a delivery from Swepson and Bangladesh are now struggling. A googly on off, it comes in. Nurul Hasan looks to defend but misses and gets hit on the pads. An appeal is put up but the umpire is not interested. Australia take the review. The Ultra Edge shows no bat while the Ball Tracker shows all reds. Swepson will be on a Hat-Trick in the next over.
Nurul Hasan comes out now.

OUT! LBW! Mahmudullah goes and Swepson gets rid of the big fish. Australia continue to do well with the ball. Full on middle, Mahmudullah looks to sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads. Australia appeal and up goes the finger. 4 down now.
Flatter ball on off, Mahmudullah defends it to cover.
Shortish ball down the leg side, Naim pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Floated outside off, Naim drives it to cover.
Flatter ball outside off, Naim cuts it through the point region for a couple.
Good length ball on off, Mahmudullah pushes it to cover.
Who is the next man in? Mahmudullah it is.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Shakib Al Hasan's struggles end! He was looking very uncomfortable at the crease. Good length ball outside off, Shakib Al Hasan looks to cut but it takes the outside edge and goes behind where Matthew Wade takes a simple catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Matthew Wade b Josh Hazlewood

Commentary.Commentary: Shortish ball around middle, Shakib Al Hasan dances down and then looks to flick but misses.
FOUR! This should release some pressure from Shakib Al Hasan! Good length ball on middle, Shakib shuffles and then paddles it to fine leg for a boundary.
On a length on the pads, Naim works it to deep square leg for one.
Good length ball on middle, Naim pushes it to mid on.
Josh Hazlewood is back on.
Floated on off, Shakib defends it to point.
Quicker ball outside off, Shakib looks to cut but misses.
Flatter on the pads, Al Hasan nudges it to deep square leg for two.
Slower through the air on off, Shakib makes room and then ends up playing back to the bowler.
Flatter on the pads, Naim tucks it to deep square leg for a run.
Flatter ball on off, Shakib cuts it to point for one.
Tossed up on middle, Shakib Al Hasan dances down the track and thern lifts it to long on for one.
Shorter and outside off, Shakib cuts it but finds the point fielder.
Tossed up on middle, Shakib Al Hasan plays it back to the bowler.
Tossed up outside off, Shakib pushes it to cover.
Very full on middle, Shakib digs it out back to the bowler.
Full on middle, Naim pushes it to long on for a single.
Ashton Agar has a change of ends.
Quicker ball on the pads, Shakib works it just outside the 30-yard circle and picks up two.
Floated on middle, Shakib defends it onto the pitch.
Floated around off, Shakib Al Hasan paddles it to the fine leg region for a couple of runs.
Full on middle, Naim works it to square leg for a single.
Flatter ball on the pads, Shakib works it short fine leg for a single.
Loopy ball on off, Naim pushes it down to long off for a single.
Very full outside off, Shakib looks to drive but misses it altogether. Bangladesh are 30 for 1 at the end of the Powerplay.
Full on the pads, Shakib Al Hasan looks to flick but it goes off the pads to the leg side.
PLAY AND A MISS! Slower ball outside off, Shakib Al Hasan looks to drive but misses.
Good length ball on middle, Naim works it to square leg for a single.
Full on off, Naim pushes it to cover.
Full on middle, Naim plays it back to the bowler.
Shorter and outside off, Shakib cuts it through the point region for two.

An appeal for LBW, turned down! Shortish around off, Shakib looks to sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads. There is an appeal for LBW but the umpire is not interested. Australia decide not to review it. That looked quite close. Well, well, that was a missed opportunity for Australia as the Ball Tracker shows all reds.
Floated on middle, Shakib pushes it back to the bowler. Agar collects and throws it back to the keeper but Shakib is in.
On middle, Shakib Al Hasan works it to mid on.
WIDE! Tossed up on middle, it skids down the leg side. Shakib leaves it alone.
Loopy ball on middle, Shakib dances down the track and then flicks it to mid-wicket.
Flatter ball on off, Shakib Al Hasan defends it out.
Around off, on a length, Naim defends it back to the bowler. A good comeback over by Josh,  4 runs and a wicket from it.

A stifled appeal for an lbw! Shortish and around middle and leg, Naim tries to work it on the leg side but misses. He is hit high the pads, they appeal but to no avail. Missing leg and also the height could have been a factor.
In the air...over the infield. A length ball outside off, Naim slices it over covers and takes two.
Shakib Al Hasan walks in next at number 3.

OUT! Misery continues for Soumya Sarkar. Back of a length delivery around off, Sarkar hangs on the back foot and tries to open the leg side field with his attempted heave across the line. But the ball takes the top edge and flies towards mid off. Mitchell Marsh is interested in taking the catch, coming across from the cover region but Alex Carey calls for it and grabs the catch safely at mid off.
Commentary.Howout: c Alex Carey b Josh Hazlewood

Commentary.Commentary: Mohammad Naim wants to change his bat. He will get it when he returns on strike.
Fuller in length on middle, Naim plays a mistimed drive down towards mid on for a run.
Back of a length ball on middle, Naim turns to pull but the bounce gets big on him. He ends up top-edging it towards point and the ball lands safe. Dot ball.
Called a no ball for overstepping! Short in length and outside off, extra bounce, Naim stands back to slam it over point but misses. Free Hit coming up...
Tossed up delivery outside off, Sarkar tries to tap and run but it goes quickly to point. Another 10-run over.
Shorter and wider outside off, Sarkar attempts to cut but misses again.
A hint of away spin, around off, Sarkar tries to defend but it whizzes past the outside edge.
Eases a full ball down to long off for a single.
Two wides! Turner fires this one down the leg side, Sarkar fails to flick and the keeper fails to collect. They cross.
SIX! Up and over long off! Tossed up ball around off, fuller in length, Sarkar lofts it over the fielder near the fence for a biggie. The fielder was interested for a while but it went over him.
Fuller in length and around leg, it's tucked behind square leg where the fielder moves to his right and then loses his balance. It goes past his left side and the batsmen cross.
Slower one, a touch short again and around off, Naim plays it late and nudges it down to third man for a run. 10 runs from the over!
FOUR! Consecutive boundaries! This time square of the wicket on the off side. Short again, outside off and angling away, Naim reaches out and steers it through backward point for a boundary.
FOUR! Fine shot! A loose delivery, fractionally short and around leg, Naim picks it up early and flicks it over square leg for a boundary.
Fine leg comes up. Square leg drops back.
An inswinger this time, on a length and around off, Sarkar defends it from the inner half to square leg and runs to the other end.
A 125.4 kph delivery, a touch short around middle and off and there is some extra bounce, Sarkar stays back and plays it down at the last moment to the off side.
Back of a length ball on off, angling away, Sarkar taps it down to cover-point and looks for a run. He is sent back immediately by his partner.
Josh Hazlewood to run in from the other end. He has been exemplary on this tour so far. One slip in place.
Fuller and on off, Naim drives it down the ground but finds the mid off fielder. Two runs from the opening over.
Shortish and on middle, Soumya goes back and nurdles it in the gap at mid-wicket for a single. He is off the mark.
Flighted delivery, full and around leg, stopping a bit on the batsman, Sarkar defends it off his pads.
Too full in length and on middle, Naim clips it through mid-wicket and takes a single. Bangladesh are away!
Quicker and flatter, a touch short around off, Naim goes back to cut but is cramped for room. It takes the inner half and rolls back to the bowler.
False start. The batsman was not ready. Ashton will have to reload.
Floated one, full and around off, Naim is on the front foot and defends it back a shade uppishly.

The players concerned are out in the centre. Mohammad Naim and Soumya Sarkar are the openers for Bangladesh. The latter has had a torrid time so far in this series and needs to redeem himself. Australia are beginning with the spin of Ashton Turner. Here we go...
Pitch report - This surface was used for the second match and is pretty hard. Lots of rolling have gone on and 130 will be a good score.

Australia (Playing XI) - Matthew Wade (WK/C), Ben McDermott, Mitchell Marsh, Moises Henriques, Alex Carey, Ashton Turner, Dan Christian, Ashton Agar, Andrew Tye (In for Nathan Ellis), Mitchell Swepson (In for Adam Zampa), Josh Hazlewood.

Bangladesh (Unchanged Playing XI) - Mohammad Naim, Soumya Sarkar, Shakib Al Hasan, Mahmudullah (C), Afif Hossain, Nurul Hasan (WK), Shamim Hossain, Mahedi Hasan, Mustafizur Rahman, Shoriful Islam, Nasum Ahmed.

Toss - Mahmudullah has won the toss and BANGLADESH ELECT TO BAT! The Bangla skipper says that they are not really over the moon and need to stay grounded and play good cricket. Adds that the pitch will be the same as before and they will have to execute their skills. Matthew Wade says that they are disappointed with their performance so far and it's another opportunity for them and they are keen to turn it around. Informs about a couple of changes with Adam Zampa and Nathan Ellis rested.

Australia's plight with the bat on a slowish deck has continued. They struggled recently in West Indies and now Bangladesh have kept those scars open. This is the worst possible preparation a team can have before the T20 World Cup. Agreed that Australia are without their first-choice players on this tour but we are not sure how the big guns would have fared in these conditions after all the spin woes for them have existed for a decade if not more.

Before the start of this tour, Bangladesh had never beaten Australia in this format and the visitors led the head-to-head battle 4-0. It's now narrowed down to 4-3 and the Bangla Tigers have a golden opportunity to not only bag a whitewash but also sneak ahead in the H2H record.

Welcome, folks! It's yet another quick turnaround in the series with back-to-back matches. The feeling of a series win over Australia would not have sunk in for Bangladesh completely and here they are, getting ready to lock horns with the Aussies in the 4th T20I in Dhaka. In a way, the hosts won't mind turning up so quickly as they have the momentum and the motivation for a clean sweep. Australia have two matches left to salvage some pride after a dismal three games. Their batting continues to be the issue and at the moment, it appears that there is no solution available. Let's see what's in store this evening.
